exposure: Tranexamic acid (TXA) use for postpartum bleeding
type of birth (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
Patients who received TXA outside WHO guidelines
Patients who received TXA within WHO guidelines
outcome: Proportion of patients receiving TXA according to WHO guidelines
Need for surgery or interventional radiology
Time to administration of first-line treatment for postpartum bleeding
cohort: 231 postpartum patients who received TXA for postpartum bleeding at a tertiary care centre from May 2017 to March 2020.
finding: The majority (87.9%) of patients received TXA within WHO guidelines and experienced fewer adverse outcomes, suggesting that TXA is being used appropriately and effectively for postpartum bleeding in this setting.
mod_finding: TXA was more commonly used at cesarean section (77.0%).
